user.title: Swiss Public Alerts
user.description: Official public alerts from Alertswiss (Federal Office for Civil Protection) and natural hazard danger levels from the Natural Hazards Portal of the Confederation. Whether your home is affected is determined from the alert area polygons and your Home Assistant home location; the danger levels use the postal code entered below.

home_alert_started.name: Alert for the home location started
home_alert_started.description: Triggers when an Alertswiss alert begins to cover the Home Assistant home location.

home_alert_cleared.name: Alert for the home location cleared
home_alert_cleared.description: Triggers when no Alertswiss alert covers the home location any more.

alert_count_increased.name: Alert count increased
alert_count_increased.description: Triggers when a count sensor goes up: a new alert was published (all of Switzerland, or the home location, depending on the sensor).

home_is_affected.name: Home location is affected
home_is_affected.description: Tests if an Alertswiss alert covers the home location.

home_is_not_affected.name: Home location is not affected
home_is_not_affected.description: Tests if no Alertswiss alert covers the home location.

unreachable.title: Swiss Public Alerts: data service unreachable
unreachable.description: The service at {host} has not answered for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the service itself is down. The entities stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

plz_unknown.title: Swiss Public Alerts: postal code {plz} unknown
plz_unknown.description: The postal code {plz} is not in the location dataset of the natural hazard portal, so the natural hazard sensors are unavailable. Check the postal code in the entry's Configure dialog; a four-digit Swiss postal code is expected. This notice disappears once the entry loads with a known postal code.
